node.title: Re^3: How to redefine a modules private function?
node.author: soonix
node.doctext:
Update: sorry, this is rubbish - see [id://11141954]

Can't get AnyEvent installed ATM, but your little demo does work, if you don't "re"define it, but define it before you load the module:

[https://www.perlmonks.org/?node_id=11141908;abspart=1;displaytype=displaycode;part=2|Foo.pm] as in [id://11141908|your example]

test2.pl use warnings; use strict; use lib '.'; BEGIN { sub Foo::ONE () { 444 } sub Foo::TWO { 555 } sub Foo::THREE () { 666 } } use Foo; # _after_ your "re"definitions Foo::go; print "One=", Foo::ONE, ", Two=", Foo::TWO, ", Three=", Foo::THREE, "\n";
